subject: Helios inference scope & SDK logistics — streaming + rerank
messages:
From: Ali Khan <ali@helios.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@helios.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Call recap: Helios evaluation — initial notes

Mina / team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — good discussion. I wanted to capture the things that landed as our primary concerns on the Helios side so we can make sure any next-step engineering work aligns with our constraints:

- Latency/p95: our rerank pipeline currently sits at ~450ms p95 for a 3-variant rerank call. We need to get that closer to 150–200ms to be viable for the product UI.
- Cost per user: model cold-starts and per-request model loads are the biggest cost drivers; we're running many small requests across sessions.
- Streaming for UX: the UI wants partial results (first-pass candidate scores) to render immediately while rerank finishes.
- Structured output: downstream systems rely on a strict JSON schema (entities + confidence) from responses.
- Embedding consistency: we use embeddings for recall + approximate nearest neighbour; changes in embedding dimensionality or normalization will break our index.

We are also sensitive to procurement timelines — we prefer predictable pricing and a path to a dedicated/reserved throughput model if the pilot goes well. Please confirm whether the streaming + function-calling route you showed can meet the latency goals with a dedicated capacity setup, and what SDK changes we'd need to adopt.

If you can map each pain point to the concrete Redwood recommendation and an engineering milestone, that would help our internal prioritization.

Thanks,
Ali Khan
Head of Machine Learning, Helios AI
ali@helios.ai

--

Ali / Priya — thanks for the clear notes. Replying with a concise mapping of pain -> recommendation and proposed milestones so we have a single shared artifact to iterate on. I attached a one-pager and a small SDK patch that shows the streaming websocket flow we typically recommend.

Summary mapping (short):
- Latency (p95 target 150–200ms): route rerank traffic to Dedicated pool with 1x quantized rerank variant (we benchmarked this on A100-like nodes at ~120–180ms p95 for the 3-variant setup). Also enable KV prefix caching for repeated session context.
- Cost per user: Dedicated pricing + autoscale + persistent model warm pools reduces per-token cost by ~35% vs cold-hosted calls. We can provide a pilot commit that caps monthly spend.
- Streaming UX: use Redwood streaming websocket (SDK change: new StreamClient stream_rerank() helper — see attached patch). This will send partial candidate scores as they are available and final structured output as the last event.
- Structured outputs + function-calls: we recommend using function-calling with a strict JSON schema for entity extraction; Redwood will validate shape at the model boundary and emit a schema violation hook if the model returns malformed JSON.
- Embedding stability: we will pin an embedding model version and provide an embedding normalization utility in the SDK to match your existing index (L2 normalize + 512-d float32).

Proposed milestones (high-level, dependent on contract sign-off):
1) Week 0 (contract): Pilot token + sandbox Dedicated pool provisioned (our infra team) — target Aug 17
2) Week 1: SDK patch review + example integration (redwood-sdk-stream branch) — target Aug 24
3) Week 2: Architecture deep-dive (1.5h) and run small-scale A/B on subset of traffic — target Aug 31
4) Week 3–4: Pilot run + performance validation + procurement paperwork (DocuSign) — target Sep 7–14

Attachments included: helix-proposal-onepager.pdf (business/ops summary), redwood-sdk-stream-diff.patch (showing StreamClient + function-calling examples), security-evidence-stub.pdf (SOC2 checklist excerpt).

Quick asks from you:
- Confirm which SDK language is primary for your engs (Python / Node / Go).
- Can you confirm the index details (embedding dim and current normalization) so we pin the right model?
- Procurement contact (if different from Priya) so we can start the DocuSign flow.

I'll loop in Aditya for pricing and Dylan for the schema/SDK review. If that plan looks right I'll send a calendar invite for the architecture deep-dive.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127
